pseudocode_defect.symptom: The exported C frees a node and returns, with no left-subtree recursion, which would leak every left subtree.
pseudocode_defect.cause: Ghidra stops disassembling after the free call at 006a07ac, so 006a07b1..006a07bb stay undefined data and never reach the decompiler. This is the no-return-annotation case AGENTS.md warns about.
pseudocode_defect.corrected_shape: for (node = arg; !_Isnil(node); ) { _Erase(_Right(node)); next = _Left(node); release payload; free(node); node = next; }

findings_outside_packet.observation: Both call sites (006a024e and two in 006a0e90) use it as the tree's node-insert helper returning an iterator, not as a length-error throw site. Not renamed: the address is outside this lease.
